recipes.name: Tortilla Agave Latte
recipes.method: Pull espresso. Add agave to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Matcha Jelly Oat Shot
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha with water, agave, salt. Set jelly with agar agar. Cut into cubes. Pour Oatly Barista over jelly and ice.
recipes.notes: Agar agar ratio: 2g per 200ml liquid

recipes.name: Acai Frozen Flat
recipes.method: Blend all acai frozen mixture ingredients until smooth. Add 75g to short glass. Pull double espresso. Gently layer espresso on top.

recipes.name: Lemon Espresso Cherry
recipes.method: Add cherry syrup and lemon juice to glass. Add ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: The Grape Cooler
recipes.method: Foam salted cold foam ingredients. Cut green grapes into chunks, add to bottom of glass. Add green tea concentrate. Blend red grapes, grape juice, Oatly and ice; pour into glass. Finish with salted cold foam.

recipes.name: Teas and Black Sugar
recipes.method: Brew black tea strong and cool. Add black sugar to glass with ice. Pour tea. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Iced Sweet & Salty Popcorn Latte
recipes.method: Drizzle caramel in glass. Add ice. Pour Oatly Popcorn. Top with espresso. Pinch of salt. Garnish with popcorn.

recipes.name: Popcorn Peppermint Mocha
recipes.method: Add chocolate sauce and peppermint syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Popcorn. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Banana Popcorn Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha. Add banana puree to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Popcorn. Pour matcha over top.

recipes.name: Caramel Miso Latte
recipes.method: Dissolve miso in espresso while hot. Add ice to glass. Pour Oatly Caramel. Top with miso espresso.
recipes.notes: White or shiro miso works best — subtle and sweet

recipes.name: Caramel Apple Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha. Add apple juice to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Caramel. Float matcha on top.

recipes.name: Strawberry & Rose Matcha
recipes.method: Add strawberry puree and rose syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float cold brew matcha on top.
recipes.notes: Serve layered — don't mix until drinking

recipes.name: Mango Refresher
recipes.method: Add mango pulp and cardamom syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista over gently.
recipes.notes: Can also use mint syrup instead of cardamom

recipes.name: Iced Gochujang Chocolate
recipes.method: Dissolve chocolate and gochujang in hot water. Cool slightly. Add ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with chocolate-gochujang base.
recipes.notes: Start with 3g gochujang and adjust to taste

recipes.name: Black Sugar Hojicha
recipes.method: Cold brew hojicha. Add black sugar syrup to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float hojicha on top.

recipes.name: French Toast Cold Brew
recipes.method: Add vanilla and cinnamon syrups to glass. Ice. Pour cold brew. Add Oatly Barista. Top with vanilla cold foam.
recipes.notes: Vanilla cold foam: blend Oatly Barista with vanilla syrup until foamy

recipes.name: Strawberry Matcha Classic
recipes.method: Layer strawberry puree at bottom. Add ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float cold brew matcha on top.

recipes.name: Strawberry Matcha Cold Foam
recipes.method: Layer strawberry. Ice. Pour matcha + Oatly Barista. Top with cold foam.

recipes.name: Pandan Melon Cold Latte
recipes.method: Add pandan and melon syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Finish with a pinch of toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
recipes.notes: Flavor arc: coffee base → floral/herbal → fresh sweet melon → citric/electric finish. Use washed Ethiopian roast for best synergy. Sichuan pepper can also be infused into pandan syrup.

recipes.name: Osmanthus Espresso Latte
recipes.method: Add osmanthus syrup and yuzu to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.
recipes.notes: Osmanthus notes: apricot, peach, honey, tea flower. Very delicate — don't overpower with strong roast. Yuzu adds citric/floral lift without dominating.

recipes.name: Osmanthus Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Cold brew matcha with less agave (osmanthus already sweet). Add osmanthus + yuzu to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha.
recipes.notes: Cardamom verde works as yuzu alternative. Shiro possible but riskier. Pair: osmanthus + matcha as menu duo with shared thread.

recipes.name: Papaya & Basil Seed Smoothie
recipes.method: Blend all papaya puree ingredients. Add basil seeds and set aside 30 min for seeds to swell. Add ice and Oatly Barista Edition and stir. Serve over lots of ice.

recipes.name: Teas & Black Sugar
recipes.method: Black sugar syrup: dissolve sugar in hot water over low heat, boil then cool. Add 25g black sugar syrup to glass. Add ice and Oatly Barista. Top with cold brewed matcha. Foam hojicha cold foam ingredients. Finish with cold foam.

recipes.name: Koji Caramel Hot Choc

ingredients.name: Vegan hot chocolate powder or flakes

recipes.method: Koji caramel: whisk koji paste and Oatly Barista Edition over low heat. Melt sugar separately until deep amber. Reduce heat, add warm koji-barista mix whisking until smooth. Simmer 1-2 min. For drink: drizzle koji caramel in cup. Add chocolate powder, 1 tbsp koji caramel and hot water, stir. Heat Oatly Barista and pour over.
recipes.notes: Koji caramel: fermented koji adds umami-sweet depth. Shiro miso can substitute.

recipes.name: Campfire Latte
recipes.method: Heat Oatly Barista Edition and marshmallows on low heat stirring until dissolved (don't boil). Add espresso, cayenne and lapsang tea concentrate to cup. Top with warm marshmallow Oatly. Finish with smoked salt and toasted marshmallow.

recipes.name: Osmanthus Cold Brew Tonic
recipes.method: Syrup: steep osmanthus flowers in boiling water 5-7 min. Strain, stir in sugar. Foam Oatly Cold Foam with osmanthus syrup. Add ice and 20ml syrup to glass. Top with tonic water and cold brewed coffee. Finish with cold foam.
recipes.notes: Osmanthus syrup recipe: 5g flowers, 100ml hot water, 100g white sugar.

recipes.name: Pomelo, White Tea & Chocolate
recipes.method: Foam pomelo cold foam ingredients. Melt white chocolate chips and salt in boiling water. Add Oatly Barista Edition and stir. Fill glass with ice. Pour white chocolate Oatly mix. Top with cold brewed white tea. Finish with pomelo cold foam.

recipes.name: Mate Cola Latte
recipes.method: Peel lime and orange zest, juice fruit. Brew yerba mate in water 5 min. Add all remaining syrup ingredients (except citrus juice) to pan, boil 1-2 min. Remove from heat, add citrus juices. Strain, store. For drink: add 20g syrup to cup, steam Oatly Barista and pour.

recipes.name: Fig Leaf Matcha
recipes.method: Fig leaf syrup: wash leaves, pour hot sugar syrup over them. Cool then refrigerate 4h minimum. Remove leaves, store chilled. Fill glass with ice. Add 20ml fig leaf syrup. Top with Oatly Barista Edition. Finish with cold brewed matcha.
recipes.notes: Fig leaf has a coconut-woody flavour. Substitute: toasted coconut syrup.

recipes.name: Oat Tepache
recipes.method: Place pineapple skin and core in sterilised vessel. Dissolve sugar in water, pour over pineapple. Top up with Oatly Barista Edition until pineapple bits are covered. Cover loosely. Leave 4-5 days in fridge. When at desired fermentation, strain. Serve over lots of ice.
recipes.notes: 4-day fermentation. Serve immediately once poured — fizzy.

recipes.name: Persimmon Cold Brew
recipes.method: Blend all persimmon puree ingredients together. Pour into glass. Top with ice. Add Oatly Barista Edition and stir. Finish with cold brewed coffee.

recipes.name: Matcha Jell-Oat Shot
recipes.method: Blend Oatly and matcha powder. Put apple juice, sugar and agar agar in pan, bring to boil. Boil 1 min whisking constantly. Remove from heat, add Oatly matcha mix, whisk. Strain into container, set 1-2h. Cut into 6-8 shots.
recipes.notes: Agar ratio: 2g per 200ml liquid.

recipes.name: Mochi Matcha
recipes.method: Mochi: whisk all mochi ingredients smooth. Heat stirring until sticky dough forms. Chill. Roll pieces in rice flour. Add 40g mochi to glass. Top with ice, Oatly Barista and cold brewed matcha. Foam matcha cold foam ingredients. Finish with aerated cold foam.

recipes.name: Lychee Oolong & Jell-Oat
recipes.method: Make Oatly jelly: boil water, sugar and agar agar 1 min whisking. Remove from heat, add Oatly Barista, whisk. Strain into container, refrigerate 1-2h. Add 40g jelly to glass. Top with ice. Add lychee juice/syrup and oolong concentrate.

recipes.name: Hojicha Old Fashioned
recipes.method: Dissolve salt, acid, hojicha and boiling water with electric whisk. Add maple syrup, bitters, spirit and chilled Oatly Barista Edition (will curdle). Pass through paper coffee filter until clear (pass cloudy liquid twice). Bottle and refrigerate. To serve: pour 125ml over clear ice, garnish with orange twist.
recipes.notes: Clarification optional for visual impact.

recipes.name: Tortilla & Agave Latte
recipes.method: Infusion: warm Oatly, agave and tortilla chips over low heat 5 min (don't boil). Cool, strain. Rim half the glass with agave and crushed spicy chips. Fill with ice. Add tortilla-infused Oatly. Finish with double espresso.
recipes.notes: Infuse at low heat — do not boil.

recipes.name: Lemon Espresso con Cherry

ingredients.name: Oatly Whippable Creamy Oat (for lemon top)

recipes.method: Whip all lemon creamy oat ingredients with electric mini whisk to scoopable texture. Pull double espresso into small cup. Dollop lemon creamy oat on top. Finish with a cocktail cherry.

recipes.name: Brazilian Lemonade
recipes.method: Blend all ingredients until smooth (30s-1min). Strain out lime residue. Serve over lots of ice immediately.
recipes.notes: Must be consumed immediately. Do not let it sit — it separates.

recipes.name: Ashotchu (A-shot-choo)
recipes.method: Mix yuzu and honey. Add to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Ube Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Add ube syrup to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float cold brewed matcha on top.
recipes.notes: Ube gives striking purple colour — serve layered.

recipes.name: Tomato Vine Soda Float
recipes.method: Add basil syrup to glass with ice. Pour tomato vine juice and sparkling water. Float Oatly Barista on top.
recipes.notes: Unexpected savoury float — great for brunch menus.

recipes.name: Rosemary Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Make rosemary syrup (rosemary + sugar + water). Cold brew matcha. Add rosemary syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly. Float matcha.

recipes.name: Coffee & Cranachan
recipes.method: Add raspberry and oat syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso.
recipes.notes: Inspired by the Scottish dessert cranachan. Toasted oat syrup: toast oats, steep in sugar syrup.

recipes.name: Miso Banana Cubano Blanco
recipes.method: Dissolve miso in warm espresso. Cool. Add banana syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly. Top with miso espresso.

recipes.name: Smokey Matcha
recipes.method: Make smoked sugar syrup. Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha on top.

recipes.name: The Snowcap
recipes.method: Add jasmine syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha. Top with thick Oatly Cold Foam.

recipes.name: The No Brainer
recipes.method: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Tea x Coffee Latte
recipes.method: Brew Earl Grey strong and cool. Add vanilla syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly. Layer cold brew tea. Top with espresso.

recipes.name: Cherry Bakewell Dirty Soda
recipes.method: Add cherry and almond syrups to glass with ice. Pour sparkling water. Float Oatly Barista on top.

recipes.name: Horchata Latte
recipes.method: Add horchata syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Dust with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Maple Miso Latte
recipes.method: Dissolve miso in espresso. Add maple syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Add miso espresso.
recipes.notes: Also works hot: steam Oatly with miso and maple, top with espresso.

recipes.name: Lacto-Fermented Blueberry Matcha
recipes.method: Ferment blueberries with salt 3-5 days. Strain and make shrub with sugar and vinegar. Add shrub to glass. Ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha.
recipes.notes: Advanced fermentation technique — plan 3-5 days ahead.

recipes.name: Coconut Matcha Cloud
recipes.method: Add coconut syrup to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha. Top with thick cold foam.

recipes.name: Guajillo Cold Brew Latte
recipes.method: Make guajillo syrup (dried chili + sugar + water). Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour cold brew. Top with Oatly Barista.
recipes.notes: Guajillo: mild fruity heat with berry notes.

recipes.name: Salty Banana Split
recipes.method: Blend Oatly, banana, caramel and ice until smooth. Pour. Drizzle chocolate. Finish with salt.

recipes.name: Apricot & Thyme Matcha
recipes.method: Blend apricots, thyme and sugar for puree. Add 30g puree to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly. Finish with cold brewed matcha.
recipes.notes: Timesaver: swap Barista + matcha for 240ml Oatly Matcha Oat Drink.

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice Slushie
recipes.method: Blend Oatly, mango, coconut syrup and ice until slushy. Pour. Top with a spoonful of sticky rice.

recipes.name: Strawberry & Almond Shrub
recipes.method: Make strawberry shrub (strawberries + sugar + apple cider vinegar, 3 days). Add shrub and almond syrup to glass with ice. Top with sparkling water and Oatly.

recipes.name: Lime & Leaf Chai
recipes.method: Make kaffir lime leaf syrup. Add syrup to glass with ice. Pour chai concentrate. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Rose Cardamom Coffee Cloud
recipes.method: Add rose and cardamom syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Top with espresso. Finish with cold foam.

recipes.name: Guava & Coconut Shaken Espresso
recipes.method: Shake espresso, guava syrup and ice vigorously. Pour into glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista gently. Add coconut syrup.

recipes.name: Cantaloupe Matcha
recipes.method: Add cantaloupe puree and agave to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista. Float matcha on top.

recipes.name: Peach Sago Tea
recipes.method: Cook sago pearls. Add peach syrup and sago to glass. Fill with ice. Pour peach tea. Top with Oatly Barista.

recipes.name: Banana French Toast Brûlée
recipes.method: Add syrups to glass with ice. Pour Oatly Barista and espresso. Top with cold foam. Sprinkle sugar on foam and brûlée with torch.

recipes.name: Ginger Nut Chai
recipes.method: Fill glass with ice. Add nut syrup and ginger juice. Stir. Top with Oatly Barista Edition. Finish with chai concentrate.
recipes.notes: Any nut syrup works. Except pistachio.

recipes.name: Pear & Cardamom Thai Tea
recipes.method: Toast cardamom pods and lightly crush. Add to pan with pear juice and sugar. Bring to simmer, reduce by half. Cool 1–2h, strain, chill. Fill glass with ice. Add syrup and pear juice. Stir. Top with Oatly Barista Edition. Finish with thai tea concentrate.
recipes.notes: In medieval times, cardamom was thought to help protect against the cold.

recipes.name: Mulled Cranberry Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Simmer all syrup ingredients 5 min until reduced by half. Cool, strain, chill. Fill glass with ice. Add cranberry syrup and Oatly Barista Lighter Taste. Finish with cold brewed matcha.
recipes.notes: Shortcut: use Oatly Matcha Oat Drink instead of Barista + cold brewed matcha.

recipes.name: Gochujang Hot Chocolate

ingredients.name: Vegan hot chocolate powder or flakes

recipes.method: Stir chocolate powder and gochujang into hot water until smooth. Steam/heat Oatly Barista Edition. Pour over chocolate mix. Finish with gochugaru.
recipes.notes: 5–10g gochujang depending on heat preference.

recipes.name: Ye Olde Oatly

ingredients.name: Stout beer (regular or alcohol-free) for syrup

recipes.method: Simmer stout and sugar until reduced by half (~10 min). Cool, store chilled. Froth Oatly Organic Creamy Oat with vanilla, maple and salt until thickened. Add stout syrup and hot filter coffee to cup. Stir. Finish with salted vanilla top.
recipes.notes: Inspired by a British stout. The salted vanilla top mimics the creamy head.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Roll Smoothie
recipes.method: Soak dates and cinnamon in boiling water 10 min, blend to smooth paste for drizzle. Blend all smoothie ingredients 20-30 sec until smooth. Optional: drizzle Oatly Creamy Oat around glass edge. Build in layers: ⅓ smoothie, ½ cinnamon drizzle, repeat.
recipes.notes: It's a Swedish thing. Hur som helst, Swedish or not, om du gillar kanelbullar du kommer love this one.

recipes.name: Smoked Rosemary Hot Choc
recipes.method: Burn rosemary sprig until charred and smoking. Add to pan with Oatly Barista Edition, dark chocolate and smoked salt. Heat but don't boil — stir to melt chocolate. Remove rosemary. Pour and serve.
recipes.notes: Garnish with extra smoked salt and rosemary leaves. Needs a blow torch.

recipes.name: Double Tea
recipes.method: Add jasmine concentrate, matcha and agave to glass and stir. Steam Oatly Barista Lighter Taste and pour into glass. Top with Oatly Whipped Creamy Oat if using.
recipes.notes: Shortcut: use Oatly Matcha Oat Drink instead of Barista + cold brewed matcha.

recipes.name: Apple Pie Chai
recipes.method: Steam/heat all together. Enjoy.
recipes.notes: Skill level 1/5 — the easiest recipe in the book.

recipes.name: Malted Spiced Choco

ingredients.name: Vegan hot chocolate powder or flakes

recipes.method: Add malt extract, chocolate powder and hot water to glass. Stir until incorporated. Add ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition and chai concentrate. Finish with orange zest.

recipes.name: Yuzu White Choc Mocha
recipes.method: Pull double espresso over white chocolate chips. Add yuzu juice and stir to melt chocolate. Pour into ice-filled glass. Finish with Oatly Barista Edition.
recipes.notes: Can use 10-20ml white chocolate syrup instead of chips.

recipes.name: Sticky Toffee Irish Coffee

ingredients.name: Whole spices (2 cloves, ½ cinnamon stick, 3 black cardamom pods)

recipes.method: Combine all ingredients except Oatly Whippable in a cafetière. Steep 5 min. Plunge and pour into warm glass. Lightly whip Oatly Whippable Creamy Oat and layer on top.
recipes.notes: Optional: add 25ml Irish whiskey to make it boozy.

recipes.name: Carrot Cake Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Mix Oatly Barista, carrot juice, mixed spice and brown sugar. Whip Oatly Whippable with lemon, agave and salt for 'creamy cheesy' frosting top. Fill glass with ice. Add liquid carrot cake. Top with matcha. Finish with frosting. Sprinkle chopped nuts.
recipes.notes: The frosting tastes like cream cheese frosting — not actual cheese.

recipes.name: Chia Pudding Matcha Latte
recipes.method: Blend berries, ginger juice, water and maple syrup. Stir in chia seeds. Leave overnight. Fill glass with ice. Add chia pudding. Pour Oatly Barista Lighter Taste. Top with cold brewed matcha.
recipes.notes: Prepare chia pudding the night before. Shortcut: use Oatly Matcha Oat Drink.

recipes.name: Sweet Tahini Hojicha Latte
recipes.method: Make condensed Oatly: simmer Oatly Creamy Oat + sugar stirring until caramelized and thick (10-20 min). Add condensed Oatly to glass. Brew hojicha with tahini. Add hojicha-tahini mix. Top with steamed Oatly Barista Edition.
recipes.notes: Hojicha is a roasted Japanese green tea — round, soft and nutty.

recipes.name: Pumpkin 2.0

ingredients.name: Masala chai or pumpkin pie spice mix

recipes.method: Combine spices, coffee, maple syrup, salt and pumpkin puree. Add boiling water, stir. Add orange and lemon juice. Add Oatly Barista Organic (will curdle). Pass through paper coffee filter twice until clear. Stir clarified liquid with lots of ice. Strain into frozen glass. Finish with pumpkin seed oil drops.
recipes.notes: Clarification technique: pass twice through paper coffee filter to get crystal clear liquid.

recipes.name: Black Sesame Hojicha Einspänner
recipes.method: Whip all creamy top ingredients together to scoopable thickness. Fill glass with ice. Add Oatly Barista Lighter Taste. Top with hojicha. Finish with black sesame creamy top.
recipes.notes: Black sesame paste gives deep nutty-bitter flavour.

recipes.name: Salted 'Egg' Custard Latte
recipes.method: Custard: whisk pumpkin puree, sugar, salt and cornstarch smooth. Whisk in Oatly Barista. Heat stirring constantly until thick and bubbling. Cool. Load custard into whipped cream syphon with gas canister. Build drink: ice + Oatly Barista + double espresso. Top with aerated custard from syphon.
recipes.notes: Pumpkin puree gives golden colour. Kala namak adds egg-like aroma. Requires whipped cream syphon.

recipes.name: Elderflower Blanc
recipes.method: Pull a double espresso and allow to cool for 30 seconds. In a tall glass, combine elderflower syrup and fresh lemon juice over a full glass of ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition over the ice, then slowly pour the espresso over the back of a spoon to create a gentle layered effect before serving. Optionally garnish with a thin lemon wheel or a few dried elderflowers.
recipes.notes: Opens with a delicate, high-floral elderflower note that lifts immediately on the nose. The lemon juice adds a whisper of citrus brightness that sharpens the sweetness without tipping sour. The creamy, neutral body of Oatly Barista threads through the mid-palate, softening the espresso's bittersweet finish into something clean and almost white-wine-like. Light, aromatic, and effortlessly summery.

recipes.name: Jardín de Seda
recipes.method: A delicate collision of floral osmanthus and perfumed lychee wrapped around a bold double espresso, softened by the creamy neutrality of Oatly Barista. The result is a latte that drinks like a stroll through a silk road garden — aromatic, slightly exotic, and surprisingly balanced.
recipes.notes: Key combo: osmanthus, lychee | Complexity: Easy

recipes.name: Dragón del Mediterráneo
recipes.method: A shaken espresso builds a bold base beneath a vivid swirl of dragon fruit and whisper-soft elderflower, topped with a cascade of Oatly Barista cold foam for a dramatic pink-and-white finish. The bittersweet espresso cuts through the fruity floral sweetness in a way that feels Mediterranean and effortlessly cool.
recipes.notes: Key combo: dragon fruit, elderflower | Complexity: Medium

recipes.name: Melón de Noche
recipes.method: A warming cortado-style drink where melon syrup brings an unexpected honeydew sweetness and osmanthus adds a late-evening floral depth, steamed together with velvety Oatly Barista. It sounds unconventional but the gentle fruit note softens the espresso's edge in the same way caramel does — only stranger and more beautiful.
recipes.notes: Key combo: melon, osmanthus | Complexity: Easy

recipes.name: Lichi Eléctrico
recipes.method: Blended with ice, Oatly Barista, and a double espresso shot, this frozen trio of lychee, dragon fruit, and elderflower creates a jewel-toned slushie that tastes like a tropical thunderstorm in a glass. The espresso hums underneath the fruity florals, giving the drink a caffeinated backbone that stops it from being just a pretty face.
recipes.notes: Key combo: lychee, dragon fruit, elderflower | Complexity: Medium

recipes.name: Novia del Verano
recipes.method: Elderflower syrup is layered beneath cold Oatly Barista and a double espresso shot, finished with a melon foam cloud that slowly dissolves into the drink as you sip. The pairing channels the feeling of a terrace lunch in late June — light, fragrant, and just sweet enough to feel like a treat.
recipes.notes: Key combo: elderflower, melon | Complexity: Medium

recipes.name: Escama Rosa
recipes.method: A built iced espresso drink where melon syrup sits at the base, lychee is stirred through the Oatly Barista pour, and dragon fruit is drizzled over the top for a sunset-gradient effect in the glass. Three fruits that each play a distinct role — sweetness, perfume, and drama — unified by the espresso's roasted depth.
recipes.notes: Key combo: dragon fruit, lychee, melon | Complexity: Advanced

recipes.name: Seda de Yuzu
recipes.method: A fragrant, floral hot latte built on white tea, where yuzu's bright citrus tension is softened by elderflower's honeyed bloom and pandan's warm vanilla-coconut undertow. The Oatly Barista Edition rounds the whole cup into something silky and almost luminous — a drink that feels like spring light through linen curtains.
recipes.notes: Key combo: yuzu, elderflower, pandan | Complexity: Easy

recipes.name: Faro de Dragón
recipes.method: Cold brew concentrate meets a vivid trio of dragon fruit's subtle berry sweetness, yuzu's electric citrus pop, and osmanthus's apricot-floral depth — all lifted through a slow pour of Oatly Barista Edition over ice. The result is a jewel-toned, layered cold brew that glows like a lighthouse at dusk.
recipes.notes: Key combo: dragon fruit, yuzu, osmanthus | Complexity: Medium

recipes.name: Bruma de Melón
recipes.method: A blended frozen drink where ripe melon sweetness and elderflower's soft floral musk meet pandan's grassy, coconut-kissed backbone — all churned with Oatly Barista Edition into a pale green-gold slush. Light, cooling, and almost dessert-like, it captures the feeling of a Barcelona summer before noon.
recipes.notes: Key combo: melon, elderflower, pandan | Complexity: Easy

recipes.name: Espejo de Jade
recipes.method: Ceremonial matcha is shaken with pandan syrup and a hit of yuzu, then poured over ice and crowned with an Oatly Barista cold foam stained faintly pink with dragon fruit — the foam sits like a reflection on still water. The drink delivers earthiness, citrus brightness, and a faintly exotic sweetness in perfect tension.
recipes.notes: Key combo: pandan, yuzu, dragon fruit | Complexity: Advanced

recipes.name: El Destilado
recipes.method: A no-coffee sparkling refresher built on cold brew hojicha, where osmanthus syrup lays down a peachy floral base, yuzu cuts through with sharp brightness, and melon adds a ripe, round sweetness — topped with sparkling water and a long pour of Oatly Barista Edition that blooms through the glass. Clean, complex, and dangerously easy to drink on a Madrid terrace.
recipes.notes: Key combo: osmanthus, yuzu, melon | Complexity: Medium

recipes.name: Corazón de Escama
recipes.method: A shaken espresso drink where a double shot is pulled over dragon fruit and elderflower syrups, then vigorously shaken with Oatly Barista Edition to create a thick, rosy-hued foam — finished with a melon syrup drizzle that slowly bleeds through the drink like sunset through stained glass. The espresso's bitterness anchors the floral sweetness into something unexpectedly sophisticated.
recipes.notes: Key combo: dragon fruit, elderflower, melon | Complexity: Advanced

recipes.name: Escama Rosa
recipes.method: Pour melon syrup directly into the base of a 350ml clear glass, then pack tightly with ice. In a small pitcher, combine cold Oatly Barista Edition with lychee syrup and stir gently to integrate, then slowly pour over the back of a spoon onto the ice to preserve the layer above the melon. Pull a fresh double espresso, allow it to cool for 30 seconds, then slowly pour over the back of the spoon on top of the Oatly layer so it floats and bleeds downward naturally. Finish by drizzling dragon fruit syrup across the espresso surface using a squeeze bottle in a slow, deliberate motion to create vivid pink streaks cascading through the glass — serve immediately without a straw so the guest sees the full gradient before stirring.
recipes.notes: The first sip hits with honeyed cantaloupe sweetness anchoring the base, which then lifts into the delicate floral perfume of lychee woven through the creamy Oatly mid-layer. The espresso brings roasted depth and a gentle bitterness that cuts through the fruit softness, while dragon fruit adds a subtle tartness and visual drama on top. As the drink is stirred, the three layers bleed into a blush-toned, lightly sweet espresso with a long, tropical finish — bright, elegant, and unmistakably Mediterranean in spirit.

recipes.name: Flor de Dragón
recipes.method: Pull a double espresso and set aside to cool slightly. In a tall 350ml glass, combine the dragon fruit purée, osmanthus syrup, and elderflower cordial, then fill the glass with ice and pour in the chilled Oatly Barista Edition, stirring gently to create a soft gradient blush layer. Slowly pour the espresso over the back of a spoon to float it on top, preserving the layered visual. Garnish with a thin dragon fruit half-moon on the rim and a pinch of dried osmanthus flowers scattered over the surface.
recipes.notes: Opens with a delicate, honeyed floral hit from the osmanthus and elderflower — summery and light. The dragon fruit purée brings a subtle tropical sweetness and a vivid magenta blush that bleeds beautifully through the creamy Oatly. As the espresso integrates with each sip, it grounds the drink with a gentle roasty bitterness that balances the floral sweetness without overpowering it. Finish is clean, refreshing, and lingering — perfect for the heat of a Barcelona afternoon.

recipes.name: Jardín de Dragón
recipes.method: Pull a double espresso and set aside to cool slightly. In a shaker, combine the dragon fruit purée, osmanthus syrup, and elderflower cordial with a small handful of ice and shake for 8–10 seconds until well integrated and lightly chilled. Fill a 400ml glass with fresh ice, pour the shaken fruit-floral base over the ice, then slowly pour the Oatly Barista Edition down the side of the glass to create a soft layered gradient. Finally, pour the espresso gently over the back of a spoon onto the milk layer to float it on top, garnish with a pinch of dried osmanthus flowers and a dehydrated dragon fruit slice on the rim.
recipes.notes: Opens with a heady wave of elderflower and delicate osmanthus blossom, giving way to the bright, subtly tropical sweetness of dragon fruit. The creamy, neutral canvas of Oatly Barista lets the floral notes sing without overpowering them, while the espresso lands at the end with a clean, rounded bitterness that anchors the whole drink. Visually striking with a magenta-to-white gradient crowned in dark espresso — equal parts garden party and Barcelona terrace energy.

recipes.name: Flor de Sauco Espresso
recipes.method: Add elderflower and lychee syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Top with double espresso. Garnish with dried edible flower.
recipes.notes: The elderflower and lychee lift the coffee without masking it. Use a light-roast or washed espresso for best results.

recipes.name: Ciruelo en Flor
recipes.method: Add cherry blossom and plum syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Float hojicha concentrate on top. Dust with freeze-dried plum powder.
recipes.notes: Can use roasted oolong concentrate instead of hojicha. The plum powder garnish adds a deep pink dusting and intensifies the stone-fruit aroma.

recipes.name: Dragón Eléctrico
recipes.method: Add dragon fruit syrup and yuzu juice to glass. Fill with ice. Pour cold brew and tonic water. Float Oatly Barista Edition on top. Garnish with dragon fruit slice.
recipes.notes: The vivid magenta layered under the white oat float is the visual sell. Build slowly for best colour separation.

recipes.name: Pandan Osmanthus Matcha
recipes.method: Add pandan and osmanthus syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Float cold brewed matcha on top. Garnish with dried osmanthus flowers.
recipes.notes: Cold brew matcha: 2.5g matcha + 0.1g salt + 5g agave + 30ml cold water, shake vigorously. Two botanicals from opposite ends of Asia that harmonise perfectly over oat.

recipes.name: Luna de Melocotón
recipes.method: Add melon and cherry plum syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour cold brew. Top with Oatly Barista Edition. Garnish with a melon ball on the rim.
recipes.notes: Tastes like late summer dusk. The coffee anchors the fruit without dominating. Works well with a medium-roast Colombian cold brew.

recipes.name: Camino de Seda

ingredients.name: White tea or jasmine tea concentrate

recipes.method: Brew white or jasmine tea strong and cool slightly. Add osmanthus and plum syrups to cup. Pour hot tea concentrate. Steam Oatly Barista Edition and pour. Dust with freeze-dried plum powder.
recipes.notes: The hot winter option of the menu. Osmanthus threads apricot-floral depth through plum's body — silky and quietly luxurious. The plum powder garnish makes it look as refined as it tastes.

recipes.name: Lichi Verde
recipes.method: Add lychee and pandan syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Float cold brewed matcha on top. Garnish with a fresh or canned lychee.
recipes.notes: Three tones of green and pink in one glass. Creamy, cooling and impossibly refreshing. One of the most photogenic drinks on the menu.

recipes.name: Brisa de Dragón
recipes.method: Add dragon fruit puree and elderflower syrup to glass. Fill with ice. Pour sparkling water. Float Oatly Barista Edition gently on top. Garnish with fresh mint.
recipes.notes: Caffeine-free — the non-coffee option for the menu. Vivid fuchsia base, white oat float, green mint — photographs beautifully. Converts sceptics on first sip.

recipes.name: Sakura Espresso
recipes.method: Add cherry blossom syrup and yuzu juice to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Top with double espresso. Garnish with a cherry blossom.
recipes.notes: The yuzu adds a sharp citric lift that cuts through the espresso and contrasts with the delicate floral sweetness of cherry blossom. Use a washed light roast for best results.

recipes.name: Pandan Mint Espresso
recipes.method: Add pandan and green mint syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Top with double espresso. Garnish with fresh mint sprig.
recipes.notes: Pandan gives a grassy vanilla-coconut base that plays beautifully against the herbal freshness of mint. The espresso anchors both without competing.

recipes.name: Ciruela Negra Espresso
recipes.method: Add plum and cherry plum syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Top with double espresso. Dust rim with freeze-dried plum powder.
recipes.notes: Deep, jammy and complex — the darkest flavour profile in the menu. Works best with a natural-process espresso that already has stone-fruit notes. The double plum combo amplifies the coffee's sweetness without adding sugar-bomb heaviness.

recipes.name: Melon Osmanthus Espresso
recipes.method: Add melon and osmanthus syrups to glass. Fill with ice. Pour Oatly Barista Edition. Top with double espresso. Garnish with dried osmanthus flowers.
recipes.notes: Melon's cool pale sweetness meets osmanthus's apricot-honey floral depth — together they create a soft, summery canvas that the espresso cuts through cleanly. One of the most unexpected combinations that just works.

recipes.name: Rollo de Canela
recipes.method: Pull a double espresso directly over the cinnamon roll syrup and brown sugar syrup in a shaker, stir briefly to dissolve, then fill the shaker with ice and add the Oatly Barista Edition cold. Seal and shake hard for 8 seconds to create a light, frothy texture, then strain over a fresh glass packed with ice. Finish with a generous pinch of ground cinnamon dusted across the surface for aroma and visual appeal.
recipes.notes: Opens with the warm, buttery sweetness of a freshly baked cinnamon roll, with the espresso cutting through cleanly on the mid-palate. The Oatly Barista brings a creamy, naturally oat-forward body that echoes the pastry dough quality of the syrup. The finish is gently spiced and sweet without being heavy — a summer treat that feels indulgent but drinks light and refreshing.
